rows.text: After a moment of silence, the "Clockie" before you suddenly transforms into a haggard-looking man.
Phew... I'm so sorry. I don't feel very well. Could you give me a moment to rest?
rows.speaker: Wolpe

rows.text: Ahh... Thank you for your kindness...
rows.speaker: Wolpe

rows.text: You're just clocking off right now, huh?
Sorry... I know this is extremely unprofessional but... I just need... to breathe for a moment...
rows.speaker: Wolpe

rows.text: The exhausted man falls silent again, his expression empty and his eyes unfocused.
For some reason, you find yourself wanting to talk to him. Maybe his pitiable expression has inspired some kind of sympathy in you, or maybe his depression is infectious.
So, you approach him and gently pat his slumped shoulders.
Huh? Oh, s—sorry, I didn't notice you... Did you want to interact with one of the characters? There are more actors over there...
rows.speaker: Wolpe

rows.text: Haha... Do you want to hear me whinge? Ah... Since you're still here, I'll take that as a yes.
rows.speaker: Wolpe

rows.text: A man like me, well... Ah, how do I put this? I know they all think I'm stupid... I mean, no one else at my age still thinks that people can rely on their dreams to make a living, right?
rows.speaker: Wolpe

rows.text: At first... After I retired, I didn't listen to them and didn't use my fame to live off of advertising deals. Instead, I came running straight to Penacony to be a costumed performer for my favorite Clockie.
rows.speaker: Wolpe

rows.text: In the end, this job was nothing like I imagined... What's worse, the hotel fees have used up the majority of my savings, and now my body is in no state to get back into the competitive arena...
rows.speaker: Wolpe

rows.text: If you ask me "Do you regret it?" ...Even I'm not sure, haha. All I know is that, right now, I feel like Clockie without Mr. Soda. I can't get my spirits up, or ignite even a spark of enthusiasm...
rows.speaker: Wolpe

rows.text: Ah, I've ranted for so long, you must be tired of listening to all this. Thank you for listening to my complaints. I actually feel... a lot better now.
rows.speaker: Wolpe

rows.text: After a brief silence, Clockie appears before your eyes once more.
Dear friend, Clockie is here to serve you today, tick-tock!
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: My dear friend, Clockie is here to serve you, tick...
rows.speaker: Clockie

rows.text: Sorry, I just need to take a quick rest, just a quick one...
rows.speaker: Clockie
